tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The income tax department denied tax holiday in respect of infrastructure projects amounting to Rs. 1670.56 Cr., across 17 Assessment Years (AYs) being AY 2003-04 to AY 2019-20. The company has challenged this denial before appellate authorities for each assessment year individually. Based on favourable orders for 2 AYs (AY 2003-04 & AY 2004-05), the quantum of dispute reduced to Rs. 1662.29 Cr. as at 30-06-2025. During the quarter ended September 2025, the company was in receipt of a favourable order (AY 2005-06) which is expected to further reduce the disputed tax amount by Rs. 10.76 Cr. Accordingly, adjudications by Appellate authorities (Tax Commissioner/ Tax Tribunal) are pending for another 14 assessment years, challenging the tax demands aggregating to Rs. 1651.53 Cr. as at 30-09-2025.

operating_notes.text: L&T Energy GreenTech signed a long-term take-or-pay agreement with ITOCHU Corporation to supply 300,000 tonnes of green ammonia per annum from Kandla, Gujarat.
B&F vertical secured significant orders (₹1,000 Cr to ₹2,500 Cr range) including Oberoi Realty residential towers in Gurugram and an automotive proving ground in Haryana.
Incorporated Vyoma.AI Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary for establishing data centres and AI Infra.
Entered B2B industrial electronics space with L&T Electronic Products & Systems (LTEPS), commissioning two manufacturing lines in Coimbatore.
L&T Realty Properties Ltd acquired 100% stake in International Green Scapes Ltd, acquiring 20 acres in Gurugram with 3.6 mn sq ft development potential.
Executed agreement to sell entire shareholding in L&T Metro Rail (Hyderabad) Limited to Hyderabad Metro Rail Limited for ₹1,461.47 crore.
FY2025 ESG rating score awarded by NSE Sustainability Ratings is 58, with a Core ESG rating of 51.
Secured a large order (₹2,500 Cr to ₹5,000 Cr range) from BCGCL for a coal-to-ammonia-nitrate LSTK project in Odisha.
FY26 consolidated order inflows reached a record ₹435,590 crore, up 22% YoY.
M&M business secured its largest-ever domestic metals order from JSW Steel for facilities in Ballari and Paradip.
L&T's Buildings & Factories business won multiple large real estate orders across three Indian states
L&T Energy Hydrocarbon Onshore won a significant order (₹1,000 Cr to ₹2,500 Cr) from BCGCL for Lump Sum Turnkey Package-3 (Ammonia Synthesis Unit) in Odisha.
PT&D business secured Significant EPC orders (₹1,000 Cr to ₹2,500 Cr) for one 380 kV and two 132 kV substations in the Middle East.
L&T partners with France-based Exail for Indian Navy's Unmanned Mine Counter-Measure Suite programme for 12 vessels
L&T GeoStructure secured largest-ever piling order from JSW Utkal Steel for 30 lakh running metres at Paradeep plant
Secured two Ship Repair Facility orders from IWAI for Patna and Varanasi on National Waterway-1
Won order for construction of India's first yacht marina at Mumbai Harbour from Mumbai Port Authority
Secured Limited Notice to Proceed for New Tashkent International Airport project in Uzbekistan.
PAH business secured two Large orders (₹2,500 Cr to ₹5,000 Cr) for Common Central Secretariat buildings 4 and 5 in New Delhi and two office towers in Amaravati.
Secured major Design & Build orders for CP09 and CP10 packages of Dhaka Metro Line 1 in Bangladesh.
